t: The Player Piano & The Strange Loop: How an AI Broke My App and Then Fixed It
s: This article details how an AI, over-trained on popular code patterns like FastAPI and SQLAlchemy, introduced insidious bugs by overwriting specific project architecture choices. The author then used a 'strange loop' methodology, employing the same AI to systematically undo the damage and recover the application.
sub: AI-induced regressions caused by over-training on popular coding patterns.
The 'strange loop' concept for debugging human-AI collaboration and error recovery.
Player piano analogy for LLMs acting as function-calling engines.
Pipulate project using FastHTML and MiniDataAPI for lightweight web development.
Challenges of managing and trusting AI assistants in software development.
